title: Sensitivity rerun request: unsupported recomputation

claims.text: A new sensitivity recomputation was requested for this assessment, but the assessment is marked non-recomputable because historical input provenance is incomplete; the bundle supports inspection only.
No scenario recomputation was executed, and no substitute data vintage was used. Existing sensitivity variants remain available as recorded results but cannot be rerun or extended.

limitations: The assessment bundle lacks frozen inputs required by the scenario recomputation tool, so no new sensitivity run was possible.
Substituting current data for the original inputs was requested but declined because it would break provenance and produce results not attributable to the original assessment.
Existing sensitivity variants are historical labels only; they do not define a calibrated credible interval or occurrence probabilities.
